==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Hua Lielang:''' Hm? I sense strength in you, just like a flower.
:{{DIcon}} Isn't a flower a fragile being?
:'''Hua Lielang:''' Not true. Though flowers can be flexible, they have the potential to pierce through rocks. That is why I practice in this flower field.
:'''Hua Lielang:''' This fragrance can't be mistaken. You have the flower's potential. Seems like you're also someone who practices the flower's wisdom!
:{{DIcon}} I don't even know what is a "flower's potential"...
:'''Hua Lielang:''' Modest of you to say that, but since we're students of the same wisdom, why don't we have a practice against each other?
:'''Hua Lielang:''' This is simple. Being either knocked out or driven to the peripheral flowerbeds will be considered a defeat.
:{{DIcon|Attack}} I have no idea what you're talking about, but sure. I'll play along.
:{{DIcon|Exit}} Maybe not today.
----
;(After battle - If victorious)
:'''Hua Lielang:''' Hehe... Hahahaha...
:'''Hua Lielang:''' That's it! You are closer to the flower's wisdom than I do!
:'''Hua Lielang:''' A worthy opponent like you is too rare. I should thank you properly.
:'''Hua Lielang:''' I've put together a collection of treasures here. It's yours now.

;(After battle - If lost)
:'''Hua Lielang:''' Pity! What a pity! Looks like you haven't fully grasped the power of flower. Let's do this again on another occasion.
----
;(Subsequent interactions)
:'''Hua Lielang:''' Oh, it's you. You ready for another spar?
:{{DIcon|Attack}} Of course. Go on.
:{{DIcon|Exit}} Maybe not today.
{{Dialogue End}}
